about: Cleanup, dependencies, tooling, config — no behavior change
title: '[CHORE] '

---

**What**
The change, in one line.

**Why**
Why now rather than never. If there's no consequence to leaving
it, close the tab instead of filing.

**Done when**
Observable condition. For dependency bumps: version pinned and
the app still starts.

**Behavior change?**
Should be "none." If it isn't, this is a bug or an enhancement.
